characters.summary: This berserker version of Wolverine fights with completely bonded adamantium claws, savage melee onslaughts, and an accelerated healing factor that shrugs off fatal injuries.
mobility: Enhanced human running speed and agility
limitations: Subject to sensory overload or pain shock despite healing
characters.formDifferences: This variant features the complete Weapon X adamantium bonding across the entire skeleton along with the classic yellow and blue suit styling.

sources.supports: Details on the Weapon X variant and fights against Deadpool variants.

feats.claim: Fought multiple Deadpool variants using retractable adamantium claws and intense melee combat.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside Deadpool in close-quarters skirmishes.

unknowns: Exact limits of the adamantium tolerance against high-end cosmic or reality-warping attacks in this specific variant timeline.

Unverified campaign tag self-regeneration (cited source failed the automatic check): Accelerated healing factor rapidly regenerates tissue and muscle damage.
